newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina bought two soybean cargoes for Oct/Nov.
newsitem.headline: Argentina bought two soybean cargoes for Oct/Nov.

text.p: Traders in Buenos Aires said Wednesday Argentina had bought two cargoes of new U.S. soybean crop for delivery in October/November.
Asked about the purchases, one trader said "it is true." He said there were two cargoes due for delivery in October/November amounting to 60,000 tonnes. He had no further details.
Local traders said earlier in the week that Argentina was looking to buying U.S. soybeans.
